'''50,000''' ('''fifty thousand''') is the natural number that comes after 49,999 and before 50,001.

==Selected numbers in the range 50001–59999==

===50001 to 50999===

* '''50069''' = 1<sup>1</sup> + 2<sup>2</sup> + 3<sup>3</sup> + 4<sup>4</sup> + 5<sup>5</sup> + 6<sup>6</sup><ref>{{Cite web |title=A001923 - OEIS |url=https://oeis.org/search?q=A001923&language=english&go=Search |access-date=2024-02-28 |website=oeis.org}}</ref>
* '''50400''' = 27th [[highly composite number]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A002182|title=Sloane's A002182 : Highly composite numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''50625''' = 15<sup>4</sup>, smallest fourth power that can be expressed as the sum of only five distinct fourth powers, palindromic in base 14 (14641<sub>14</sub>)
* '''50653''' = 37<sup>3</sup>, palindromic in base 6 (1030301<sub>6</sub>)

===51000 to 51999===
* '''51076''' = 226<sup>2</sup>, palindromic in base 15 (10201<sub>15</sub>)
* '''51641''' = [[Markov number]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A002559|title=Sloane's A002559 : Markoff (or Markov) numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''51984''' = 228<sup>2</sup> = 37<sup>3</sup> + 11<sup>3</sup>, the smallest square to the sum of only five distinct fourth powers.

===52000 to 52999===
* '''52488''' = 3-[[smooth number]]
* '''52633''' = [[Carmichael number]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A002997|title=Sloane's A002997 : Carmichael numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
===53000 to 53999===
* '''53016''' = [[pentagonal pyramidal number]]
* '''53174''' = number of partitions of 42<ref>{{cite OEIS|A000041|a(n) is the number of partitions of n (the partition numbers)}}</ref>
* '''53361''' = 231<sup>2</sup> sum of the cubes of the first 21 positive integers

===54000 to 54999===
* '''54688''' = 2-[[automorphic number]]<ref>{{Cite OEIS|1=A030984|2=2-automorphic numbers|access-date=2021-09-01}}</ref>
* '''54748''' = [[narcissistic number]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A005188|title=Sloane's A005188 : Armstrong (or Plus Perfect, or narcissistic) numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''54872''' = 38<sup>3</sup>, palindromic in base 9 (83238<sub>9</sub>)
* '''54901''' = [[Chiliagon|chiliagonal number]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A195163|title=Sloane's A195163 : 1000-gonal numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>

===55000 to 55999===
* '''55296''' = 3-[[smooth number]]
* '''55440''' = the 9th [[superior highly composite number]];<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A002201|title=Sloane's A002201 : Superior highly composite numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref> the 9th [[colossally abundant number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A004490|title=Sloane's A004490 : Colossally abundant numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref> the 28th [[highly composite number]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=A002182 - OEIS |url=https://oeis.org/A002182 |access-date=2024-11-28 |website=oeis.org}}</ref>
* '''55459''' = one of five remaining [[Seventeen or Bust]] numbers in the [[Sierpinski number|Sierpinski problem]]
* '''55860''' = [[harmonic divisor number]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A001599|title=Sloane's A001599 : Harmonic or Ore numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''55987''' = [[repunit prime]] in [[base 6]]

===56000 to 56999===
* '''56011''' = [[Wedderburn-Etherington number]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A001190|title=Sloane's A001190 : Wedderburn-Etherington numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''56092''' = the number of groups of order 256, see [https://web.archive.org/web/20070204070922/http://www-public.tu-bs.de:8080/~beick/soft/small/small.html]
* '''56169''' = 237<sup>2</sup>, palindromic in octal (15551<sub>8</sub>)
* '''56448''' = [[pentagonal pyramidal number]]

===57000 to 57999===
* '''57121''' = 239<sup>2</sup>, palindromic in base 14 (16B61<sub>14</sub>)

===58000 to 58999===
* '''58081''' = 241<sup>2</sup>, palindromic in base 15 (12321<sub>15</sub>)
* '''58367''' = smallest integer that cannot be expressed as a sum of fewer than 1079 tenth powers
* '''58786''' = [[Catalan number]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000108|title=Sloane's A00108 : Catalan numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''58800''' = initial number of first century ''xx''00 to ''xx''99 containing as few as three [[prime number]]s<ref name="A186311">{{cite OEIS|A186311|Least century 100k to 100k+99 with exactly ''n'' primes}}</ref> {58831, 58889, 58897}
* '''58921''' = Friedman prime

===59000 to 59999===
* '''59049''' = 243<sup>2</sup> = 9<sup>5</sup> = 3<sup>10</sup>
* '''59051''' = Friedman prime
* '''59053''' = Friedman prime
* '''59081''' = Zeisel number<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A051015|title=Sloane's A051015 : Zeisel numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''59263''' = Friedman prime
* '''59273''' = Friedman prime
* '''59536''' = 244<sup>2</sup>, palindromic in base 11 (40804<sub>11</sub>)

===Primes===
There are 924 [[prime numbers]] between 50000 and 60000.
